Each handshake is between a witch and a sorcerer, since witches don't shake hands with witches and sorcerers don't shake hands with sorcerers. Every witch shakes hands with every sorcerer exactly once, so the count is 6 × 10 = 60. The proposed solution counts this same set of pairs from both sides and gets 60 each time.
